key_highlights: ASX experienced intraday volatility, initially slumping before recovering; NAB and BHP led declines.
NAB announced significant job cuts, weighing on the financials sector.
Critica tables monster $2.7B valuation for WA rare earths play, signalling strong investor appetite for critical minerals.
Energy shares jumped amid rising oil prices, partially offsetting broader market weakness.
China's export boom flagged as an economic risk, with iron ore sentiment negative (Vale spooked).
Australia clashes with Asian energy giants over gas export crackdown, creating policy risk for LNG sector.
Multiple WA gold and manganese exploration hits boost junior miners.
AI sector volatility on Wall Street spilling into ASX tech sentiment.
Perth house price correction accelerating; new home sales dropping fast — negative for REITs and construction.
High Court coal emissions ruling adds regulatory uncertainty for coal miners.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Iron ore sentiment negative with Vale signalling concern over prices. However, WA gold exploration hits, manganese jackpot, and NT rare earths extension drive optimism in junior miners and critical minerals. Rare earths gaining momentum with Critica's $2.7B valuation.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face headwinds from iron ore softness and China demand uncertainty. Junior explorers in gold, rare earths, and manganese offer speculative upside. High Court coal ruling adds ESG and legal risk for coal-exposed names.

sectors.trend: Bearish. NAB's mass job cuts signal cost-cutting under margin pressure, dragging the sector lower. Broader ASX slump led by NAB and BHP.
sectors.implications: NAB.AX faces near-term headwinds from restructuring costs and negative sentiment. Watch CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX for contagion. Sector re-rating risk if job cuts signal broader banking sector stress.

sectors.trend: Bullish. Energy shares jumped on the day. Oil prices surging. However, Australia's clash with Asian LNG buyers over export crackdown introduces policy and contract risk.
sectors.implications: Short-term tailwind for ASX energy names from rising oil. LNG exporters (WDS.AX, STO.AX) face medium-term regulatory uncertainty from government gas export policy conflict with Asian customers.

sectors.trend: Strongly bullish. Multiple catalysts: Critica $2.7B WA rare earths valuation, NT rare earths strike extending 8km, Lachlan basin drawing NSW mining hopefuls.
sectors.implications: Positive for rare earths-focused ASX explorers and developers. Lynas (LYC.AX) as the large-cap bellwether may benefit from sector re-rating. Junior rare earths plays warrant close monitoring.

sectors.trend: Bearish. Perth leading a national house price correction. New home sales dropping rapidly. Sydney supply absorption weak.
sectors.implications: Negative for residential-exposed REITs and developers. Builders and construction materials names face volume risk. Commercial REITs less directly affected but broader property sentiment is deteriorating.

sectors.trend: Cautious. Wall Street AI alarm bells ringing; ASX initially slumped despite partial AI rebound on Wall Street. Domestic tech sector remains tethered to US sentiment.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech names vulnerable to US AI valuation correction spillover. Selective exposure warranted; prefer profitable tech over speculative AI plays.

sectors.trend: Minor negative signal. Banana shortage hitting supermarket shelves due to Queensland cool weather, adding to food inflation pressures.
sectors.implications: Marginal input cost pressure for WOW.AX and COL.AX. Not a material mover but adds to broader cost-of-living narrative.

sectors.trend: Neutral to mildly positive. Ozempic face discovery narrative reviving a major pharma player, with indirect read-through to healthcare sentiment.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains a defensive anchor. Watch for GLP-1 adjacent plays on the ASX if Ozempic narrative continues to build.

key_themes: Iron ore price weakness and China demand uncertainty pressuring large-cap miners.
Critical minerals (rare earths, manganese, gold) exploration boom in WA and NT.
NAB job cuts signalling banking sector cost pressure and potential earnings downgrades.
Rising oil prices supporting energy sector despite LNG policy headwinds.
AI volatility on Wall Street creating ASX tech sector uncertainty.
Residential property correction deepening — Perth leading, new home sales falling.
Australia-Asia LNG export policy conflict introducing regulatory risk.
High Court coal emissions ruling increasing legal and ESG risk for coal sector.
China export surplus creating geopolitical and trade friction.
Fiscal policy uncertainty with GST debate and Victoria budget pressure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NAB mass job cuts — banking sector earnings risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce financials overweight; shift to defensive yield plays. Monitor CBA.AX as quality benchmark.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price weakness — China demand uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim BHP.AX and FMG.AX positions; diversify into gold and critical minerals as commodity hedge.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI valuation correction spillover from Wall Street to ASX tech
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid speculative ASX tech/AI names; maintain exposure only to cash-generative tech companies.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: LNG export policy conflict — regulatory and contract risk for energy exporters
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WDS.AX and STO.AX for contract renegotiation risk; energy upside from oil offset by domestic policy overhang.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential property correction — developer and REIT exposure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid residential-exposed developers; prefer commercial or industrial REITs with long-lease income.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: High Court coal emissions ruling — legal and ESG risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review coal-exposed holdings; assess potential for further regulatory escalation affecting WHC.AX, YAL.AX.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China export flood and trade friction — global demand disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; prefer domestic-revenue businesses less exposed to China trade policy shifts.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate rare earths and critical minerals explorers on sector momentum
opportunities.rationale: Critica's $2.7B WA rare earths valuation, NT rare earths 8km extension, and Lachlan Basin activity signal strong sector re-rating potential.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to ASX energy sector on oil price tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Oil prices surging and energy shares outperforming on the day. Short-term momentum trade while oil remains elevated.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in WA gold explorers following new high-grade hits
opportunities.rationale: Great Southern and Kaiser gold discoveries signal active WA gold belt. Gold remains a macro hedge against AUD weakness and global uncertainty.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate CSL.AX as defensive healthcare anchor
opportunities.rationale: Healthcare sector insulated from current cyclical headwinds. CSL provides quality earnings visibility with GLP-1 adjacent optionality.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce NAB.AX exposure ahead of restructuring cost crystallisation
defensive_moves.rationale: Mass job cuts signal earnings pressure and restructuring charges. Sector sentiment negative; risk of further analyst downgrades.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim BHP.AX and FMG.AX on iron ore weakness
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore price softness, Vale concerns, and China demand uncertainty reduce near-term earnings support for iron ore majors.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential property and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Perth house price bust accelerating, new home sales falling, Sydney supply not absorbed. Sector faces volume and margin compression.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD exposure given China uncertainty and iron ore softness
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD is highly correlated with iron ore and Chinese economic activity. Downside risk to AUD if China demand disappoints further.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX faces near-term headwinds from NAB job cuts, iron ore weakness, and AI volatility spillover from Wall Street. Energy sector provides a partial offset. Expect continued choppiness on ^AXJO. Financials and materials drag likely to persist until clarity on China demand and NAB restructuring scope emerges.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots to rate cuts, stabilising the property sector and consumer sentiment. Critical minerals thematic (rare earths, manganese) offers structural upside. China risk remains the key macro swing factor for Australian equities. ESG and High Court coal rulings accelerate energy transition repricing.
key_catalysts: RBA next rate decision — any cut would be materially bullish for financials, REITs, and consumer sectors.
China iron ore demand data and property sector stimulus — key driver for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX.
NAB full restructuring scope announcement — determines depth of financials sector de-rating.
Oil price trajectory — sustaining elevated levels extends ASX energy rally.
Critica rare earths resource estimate — could trigger broader critical minerals re-rating.
AUD/USD movement — a break below 0.62 would signal deteriorating risk appetite.
Australian CPI and unemployment data — influences RBA rate path and consumer sector outlook.
High Court coal emissions appeal outcome — regulatory clarity for coal sector.
US AI earnings season — sets tone for global tech and ASX tech follow-through.
watch_list: ^AXJO (ASX 200 index) — monitor support and resistance levels.
Iron ore spot price (SGX futures) — watch for break below $90/t.
NAB.AX — restructuring cost announcements and analyst downgrades.
BHP.AX and FMG.AX — earnings sensitivity to iron ore price moves.
WDS.AX and STO.AX — LNG export policy developments.
RBA meeting minutes and Governor commentary.
China PMI and trade balance data.
US Fed communications — impact on AUD and global risk appetite.
ASX residential developer sales volumes — new home sales trend.
